title: ISO 18653:2003 — Gears — Evaluation of instruments for the measurement of individual gears
locator: Official catalogue abstract: evaluation of involute, helix, pitch, runout and tooth-thickness measurement instruments, including uncertainty using calibrated gear artefacts
notes: This standard evaluates gear measuring instruments and is not a product-gear acceptance specification. The ISO catalogue indicates it is to be revised and a replacement work item has been started; verify current status before contractual use. Full text is not archived.
